hero.title: About SpeakEx
hero.subtitle: Breaking language barriers through authentic conversations and cultural exchange

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: SpeakEx is a revolutionary language learning platform that connects people from around the world to practice languages through real, meaningful conversations. We believe that the best way to learn a language is by speaking it with native speakers and fellow learners.
mission.paragraph2: Our platform creates a unique ecosystem where everyone can be both a teacher and a learner, fostering cultural exchange while earning rewards for helping others master new languages.

realConversations.title: Real Conversations
realConversations.description: Connect with native speakers and language learners through live video sessions for authentic practice.

earnWhileLearn.title: Earn While You Learn
earnWhileLearn.description: Help others learn your native language and earn silver coins to book sessions in languages you want to learn.

globalCommunity.title: Global Community
globalCommunity.description: Join a diverse community of language enthusiasts from every corner of the world.

trackProgress.title: Track Progress
trackProgress.description: Monitor your learning journey with session logs, feedback, and achievement tracking.

personalizedLearning.title: Personalized Learning
personalizedLearning.description: Choose your topics, find partners matching your interests, and learn at your own pace.

culturalExchange.title: Cultural Exchange
culturalExchange.description: Learn not just the language, but also the culture, customs, and perspectives of different communities.

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Language Journey?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of language learners and start having real conversations today.
